title: Deribit monthly-options last-Friday full-day BTC risk veto
thesis: The complete UTC day containing Deribit's last-Friday 08:00 UTC monthly BTC options expiry may underperform other Fridays because settlement-price formation, expiring-delta decay and hedge unwinds create a recurring adverse liquidity path.
mechanism: A calendar-known monthly concentration of options and futures settlement activity can force dealers and position holders to rebalance delta and unwind expiry hedges before and after 08:00 UTC, temporarily increasing downside incidence and intraday path drawdown relative to non-expiry Fridays.
economic_rationale: A spot-only policy that exits BTC at 00:00 UTC on the last Friday and reenters at Saturday 00:00 UTC is useful only if the avoided event-day loss and drawdown exceed two fee-and-adverse-slippage transitions per month and foregone positive convexity under matched capital.
